lines.text: Liquid AI ships LFM3: six open-weight ~2B models; text fits ~1GB at 4-bit, 256K context
DeepMind Genie 4: real-time world sim with native audio; trusted-tester preview now
LiteLLM Critical: Enterprise proxy unauth file read can leak master key and provider keys

feed.headline: Liquid AI ships LFM3: six open-weight ~2B models on one backbone
feed.why: Text, vision, audio, omni, and two decision models. Built to fine-tune on one GPU and run on phones or laptops.

feed.headline: LFM3-1.7B: 256K context, ~1GB at 4-bit; AA has no Index score yet
feed.why: Liquid's own 29-bench average is 49.37 vs 47.24 for Qwen3.5-9B. Treat lab benches as marketing until AA or Epoch confirm.

feed.headline: DeepMind Genie 4 adds native audio to real-time interactive world sims
feed.why: Trusted-tester preview now; later for Google AI Ultra Project Genie and early Gemini API partners. SynthID on outputs.

feed.headline: LiteLLM Critical: Enterprise proxy unauth file read can leak master key
feed.why: Affects licensed Enterprise proxies only. Open-source without a license is not hit. Patch to the listed fixed versions.

feed.headline: OpenAI: models claim local-smoothing in all dims and that ETH is false
feed.why: Lean formalizations are public. Impagliazzo, Paturi, and Williams shepherd the ETH check. Not settled science yet.

feed.headline: OpenAI and Oracle put Oracle apps and data into ChatGPT
feed.why: Oracle AI Workspace, Security Mesh, App Composer, and SMB Bundle. US buyers can use Universal Credits on Marketplace.

feed.headline: Anthropic posts early Claude results with six drug-development partners
feed.why: BigHat, BMS, Divergence, Enveda, Generate, and The Column Group. Mostly preclinical; Anthropic also acquired Mithril Medicine.

feed.headline: Anthropic expands GSA OneGov deal: 40% off Claude for all US government levels
feed.why: Covers Enterprise, Claude for Government, and API. No minimum spend. Anthropic estimates about $1B in government savings.

feed.headline: Nvidia will invest $3B in Meta's equity raise and deepen Muse work
feed.why: Also more Vera Rubin and Vera CPU for Meta agents, plus Spectrum-X and BlueField-4. Follows Meta's large AI financing plan.

feed.headline: Oracle will offer Google TPUs on OCI starting in calendar 2027
feed.why: First hyperscaler outside Google to rent Google TPUs. TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference are named.
